name: CyTools_Storyboard
description: Storyboards for generated films: timed panels with images, structured prompts, dialogue, camera, sound and a reference library; panels staged on shared 3D sets of simple shapes or drawn in 2D; contact sheet, script and animatic exports; MiniMax H3 film and workflow exports with depth or pose control videos.
author: Cyberalien

platforms.notes: Launcher script provided, not executed on Linux.

angles.description: Degrees; values not given are kept.

bend.description: Upper body tilted to its left side.

tilt.description: Pelvis tilted, left hip up; the legs hang from it, the upper body stays.

seat.description: Pelvis height in metres when seated; null = on its feet.

r_arm.description: [raise forwards (-60..180), raise sideways (-20..180), elbow bend (0..150), turn of the arm about itself, forearm outwards (-90..90, optional)]

r_leg.description: [raise forwards (-45..130), raise sideways (-30..60), knee bend (0..150), turn of the leg about itself, knee outwards (-45..45, optional)]

r_hand.description: [curl of the thumb, index, middle, ring, little finger (0..100 %), spread of the fingers (0..30 degrees), wrist bent towards the palm (-70..80), towards the thumb (-25..35), both optional]

r_foot.description: [foot pitched toes down: on tiptoe when positive (-30..60), toes bent up (-40..70)]; the foot is flat on the ground at 0.

walks.description: The legs walk when a character in this pose moves.

operations.name: Export a MiniMax H3 film
operations.description: Turn the storyboard into a multi-segment MiniMax H3 film: film.json (a Timeline Director timeline: one window per panel with overlap frames for continuity, identity/location/shot pictures and prompts per segment), its pictures, and two ComfyUI workflows (CyTools H3 Film disk sampler, Timeline Director). The same file runs in CyTools_MiniMaxH3 on Colab.

project.description: Project folder (.cystory) or its storyboard.json; a bare name is looked up in data/projects.

shortEdge.description: Short edge of the canvas; the other side follows the storyboard aspect (multiples of 32).

overlapFrames.description: Frames each segment re-generates from the previous one (continuity); removed at assembly.

overlapOnCuts.description: Also carry continuity across plain cuts (same scene).

overlapOnFades.description: Also carry continuity across fades to/from black.

identityScope.description: Identity pictures of the characters a panel uses, or of every character in every segment.

shotPictures.description: The panel's own pictures: the main one (layout render first), all, or none.

includeVideos.description: Library items of kind video used by the panel become <Video N> references of its segment (3 at most).

includeVoices.description: An audio file among a character's files becomes its voice (<Audio N>) in the segments where it appears.

includeAudio.description: Library items of kind audio used by the panel become <Audio N>.

videoSound.description: Also give the reference videos' own sound as <Audio N>.

maxReferenceSeconds.description: Longer videos and sounds are cut to this length.

secondPass.description: SelfLift two-stage sampling (low-res steps, latent upscale, high-res steps).

controlPatchModel.description: Fun ControlNet file loaded by the ComfyUI workflow written next to film.json (films with control videos).

generatedAudio.description: Generate sound with the picture (off = silent film).

depthControl.description: Depth video of the panels staged in 3D as Fun ControlNet control: indicative (0.35, first 35 % of the steps, strong blur), guided (0.6, medium blur), strict (1.0, sharp), custom.

controlEnd.description: Share of the steps it applies to.

controlSource.description: Control video: depth of the set, OpenPose pose of the characters, auto (pose when a character is in frame), or the pose drawn over the depth (experimental).

poseFeet.description: Draw the feet (OpenPose BODY_25: heel, big toe, small toe) in the pose control.

poseHands.description: Draw the hands (OpenPose hand model, 21 points) in the pose control when they are large enough on screen.

save_options.description: Remember these options in the project.

operations.name: Convert to a MiniMax H3 workflow
operations.description: Convert the storyboard into a CyTools_MiniMaxH3 workflow (workflow.json + media/): one H3 generation per panel with its first/last frame, keyframe guides and references (characters, layout, locations, videos, voices, sounds), chaining, prompts in the H3 layout, durations trimmed to the panels, and a final edit with the storyboard transitions. Run it with run_workflow in CyTools_MiniMaxH3.

project.description: Project folder (.cystory) or its storyboard.json; a bare name is looked up in data/projects.

acceleration.description: Turbo LoRA for shots without references.

referenceAcceleration.description: Turbo LoRA for shots with references (H3 has no 8-step one for them).

chain.description: Start a shot on the last frame of the previous one: after crossfades, always, never.

longPanels.description: Panels over 15 s: chained parts, or 15 s.

shortPanels.description: Panels under 4 s: generate 4 s and trim, or keep 4 s.

exactDurations.description: Trim each shot to its panel duration (H3 rounds up to 5 + 17n frames).

layoutUse.description: The 2D/3D layout render: a reference picture, the first frame, or unused.

promptLayout.description: H3 prompt layout; auto = structured when characters are defined by pictures.

depthControl.description: Depth video of the panels staged in 3D as Fun ControlNet control: indicative (0.35, first 35 % of the steps, strong blur), guided (0.6, medium blur), strict (1.0, sharp), custom.

controlEnd.description: Share of the steps it applies to.

controlSource.description: Control video: depth of the set, OpenPose pose of the characters, auto (pose when a character is in frame), or the pose drawn over the depth (experimental).

poseFeet.description: Draw the feet (OpenPose BODY_25: heel, big toe, small toe) in the pose control.

poseHands.description: Draw the hands (OpenPose hand model, 21 points) in the pose control when they are large enough on screen.
